## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 38% | 20% | 1.2% | 0% |

Russia has the Constitution with full in-force history to the October 2022 edition and 1,790 federal acts in current text, but these are mostly amending laws signed 2000-2017: no federal law signed 2018-2026 is held, and five of the eight main codes (Civil, Criminal, Arbitrazh Procedure, Tax, Administrative Offences) are missing. Of the 82 regional repositories, 81 are catalogues with no law text and Moscow Oblast holds only 281 never-amended laws as enacted; Moscow city and all case law are absent.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
